extracted.intended_audience: regulatory stakeholders, policy professionals, insurers, state agencies, and public commenters interested in Affordable Care Act rulemakings
extracted.subtask_description: Search-results listing of Federal Register documents relating to the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA), aggregating proposed rules, final rules, notices, and information-collection requests across HHS, Treasury/IRS, DOL, and other agencies. Useful for locating regulatory standards, procedural requirements, and data-collection notices needed for notice-and-comment participation or implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for health care claims attachments transactions and electronic signatures
rubrics_metrics.description: This final rule adopts standards for health care claims attachments transactions, which will support health care claims transactions, and a standard for electronic signatures to be used in conjunction with health care claims attachments transactions (HIPAA & ACA implementation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopts technical and procedural standards under HIPAA and the ACA for claims attachments and electronic signatures; relevant to implementers of claims processing systems and regulated entities required to comply with Administrative Simplification provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Denial of coverage for failure to pay past-due premium
rubrics_metrics.description: Revises standards relating to denial of coverage for failure to pay past-due premium (Marketplace Integrity and Affordability rule).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Changes affect when and how issuers may deny coverage for unpaid premiums; relevant to issuer policies, consumer protections, and eligibility/enforcement processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'lawfully present' (exclusion of DACA recipients)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposes to exclude Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) recipients from the definition of 'lawfully present.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alters eligibility classifications for enrollment and federal financial assistance; affects whether certain noncitizen populations qualify for Marketplace coverage or other ACA programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidentiary standard for assessing agent/broker/web-broker noncompliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishes the evidentiary standard HHS uses to assess an agent's, broker's, or web-broker's potential noncompliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the burden/standard of proof and procedures HHS will use in enforcement or oversight of producers and web-brokers; relevant to compliance programs and investigations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exchange automatic reenrollment hierarchy revisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Revises the Exchange automatic reenrollment hierarchy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affects the order/priorities used by Exchanges to reenroll enrollees automatically; impacts continuity of coverage and notices to consumers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for annual open enrollment and special enrollment periods (SEPs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Revises standards related to the annual open enrollment period and special enrollment periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May change timing, eligibility triggers, documentation, and verification requirements for SEPs and open enrollment; impacts consumer access and Exchange operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards relating to failure to file and reconcile; income eligibility verifications for premium tax credits and CSRs
rubrics_metrics.description: Revises standards relating to failure to file and reconcile, and income eligibility verifications for premium tax credits and cost-sharing reductions (CSRs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Touches on verification processes, reconciliation rules with the IRS, and consequences for failing to provide information; relevant to eligibility determinations and premium subsidy administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual eligibility redetermination procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Revises procedures and standards for annual eligibility redeterminations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Impacts how Exchanges and agencies verify continuing eligibility, timelines for redetermination, and potential notices/appeals for enrollees.

rubrics_metrics.name: De minimis thresholds for actuarial value for plans subject to EHB requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Revises de minimis thresholds for the actuarial value for plans subject to Essential Health Benefits (EHB) requirements and for income-based CSR plan variations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines allowable small deviations in actuarial value when comparing plans to EHB actuarial value benchmarks; affects plan design and certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premium adjustment percentage methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Revises the premium adjustment percentage methodology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Changes how premium adjustment percentages are calculated; affects user fees, benchmark calculations, or actuarial computations used by Exchanges and issuers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on providing coverage for sex-trait modification as an EHB
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibits issuers of coverage subject to EHB requirements from providing coverage for specified sex-trait modification procedures as an Essential Health Benefit (EHB).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affects scope of covered benefits under EHB rules and plan certification; relevant for issuers determining benefit designs and for stakeholders commenting on EHB scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage of recommended preventive services without cost-sharing (PHS Act §2713)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2713 of the Public Health Service Act requires non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers offering non-grandfathered group or individual coverage to provide coverage of certain recommended preventive services without imposing any cost-sharing requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to USPSTF-recommended services and other defined preventive services; agencies propose regulatory clarifications and implementation rules that affect plan benefits and member cost-sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasonableness of medical management techniques tied to accessible exceptions process
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposes that medical management techniques used by plans and issuers for preventive services would not be considered reasonable unless the plan or issuer provides an easily accessible, transparent, and sufficiently expedient exceptions process allowing coverage without cost sharing when medically necessary as determined by the individual's attending provider.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets standards for prior authorization/management of preventive services and requires procedural safeguards for exceptions; affects plan administrative processes and provider interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for coverage of over-the-counter (OTC) contraceptive items without prescription and cost-sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposes rules requiring plans and issuers to cover certain recommended over-the-counter contraceptive items without requiring a prescription and without imposing cost-sharing; also addresses coverage of contraceptive drugs and drug-led combination products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes conditions where therapeutic equivalents may affect coverage; impacts pharmacy benefits, member access, and plan formularies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure requirement for OTC contraceptive coverage in Transparency in Coverage tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposes requiring a disclosure pertaining to coverage and cost-sharing requirements for over-the-counter contraceptive items in plans' and issuers' Transparency in Coverage internet-based self-service tools or on paper upon request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affects plan transparency obligations and tools used by consumers to understand coverage and out-of-pocket costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provider access standards and essential community provider standards for QHP certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed provisions related to provider access standards and essential community provider (ECP) standards for qualified health plan (QHP) certification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets expectations for network adequacy and inclusion of ECPs in QHP networks as part of certification criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: QHP certification of non-network plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposes standards for QHP certification of non-network plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses criteria and limits for certifying plans that rely on non-network arrangements; relevant for issuers seeking QHP certification and for consumer protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on including routine non-pediatric dental services as an EHB
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposes a prohibition on issuers from including routine non-pediatric dental services as an Essential Health Benefit (EHB).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies benefit scope for EHB benchmark designs and plan offerings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost-sharing flexibilities for catastrophic and individual market bronze plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposes cost-sharing flexibilities for catastrophic and individual market bronze plans (including plan design variations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Would permit certain cost-sharing designs that can affect affordability, cost exposure of enrollees, and plan comparability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of catastrophic plans with plan terms of up to 10 consecutive years
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposes to establish catastrophic plans with plan terms of up to 10 consecutive years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alters permissible plan-term lengths for catastrophic coverage; affects market offerings and continuity of plan types.

rubrics_metrics.name: QHP issuer quality improvement strategies (QISs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes provisions related to QHP issuer quality improvement strategies (QISs) as part of Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires issuers to develop and implement strategies to improve quality outcomes; influences issuer certification and monitoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civil money penalties (CMPs) for noncompliant issuers and responsible entities
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed provisions include civil money penalties (CMPs) for noncompliant issuers and other responsible entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies enforcement mechanisms and penalties for violations of Exchange or ACA regulatory requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards governing agents, brokers, and web-brokers
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed and final provisions establish and revise standards governing agents, brokers, and web-brokers operating in Exchanges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers certification, oversight, disclosures, conduct standards, and potential penalties; relevant for licensing/compliance functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expansion and codification of hardship exemption eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposes expansion and codification of hardship exemption eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alters who may claim hardship exemptions from statutory requirements (e.g., individual mandate-related provisions where applicable); affects eligibility determinations and exemptions processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: HHS risk adjustment and risk adjustment data validation (HHS-RADV) program provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes provisions related to HHS-operated risk adjustment and risk adjustment data validation (HHS-RADV) programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses methodologies, audits, and data submission/validation requirements that affect issuer payments and risk transfer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Medical Assistance Percentage (FMAP) rules including section 1905(y) for newly eligible adults
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 1905(y) as added by the ACA provides for an increase in the FMAP for medical assistance expenditures for newly eligible individuals (the adult group); FMAP calculations and applicable percentages are announced for states and territories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determines federal matching shares for Medicaid/CHIP for the adult expansion population; affects state budgeting and eligibility implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disaster-recovery FMAP adjustment criteria and rates
rubrics_metrics.description: The Social Security Act adjusts the regular FMAP rate for qualifying states that have experienced a major, statewide disaster; notices announce adjusted FMAP rates for affected fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies eligibility and calculation of disaster-recovery FMAP adjustments; relevant for states seeking enhanced federal matching after disasters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic Health Program (BHP) provisions and payment calculation revisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed provisions include revisions affecting which enrollees are included in Federal Basic Health Program (BHP) payment calculations to States and other BHP-related standards (Section 1331 option).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affects state decisions to operate a BHP, payment formulas, and program administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy Act matching program notices for CMS data sharing with State-Based Entities or SSA
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices describe re-establishment or establishment of matching programs between CMS and State-Based Administering Entities (AEs), and between CMS and the Social Security Administration (SSA), to provide data for determining eligibility for enrollment in state health subsidy programs or insurance affordability programs under the ACA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These matching program notices explain purpose, routine use, data elements, and comment periods; they set expectations for data sharing required to implement eligibility and enrollment systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information collection, third-party notice, and disclosure requirements for internal claims and appeals and external review processes (PHS Act §2719)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information collection requests and final regulations set forth the information collection and third-party notice and disclosure requirements that plans must satisfy under regulations implementing ACA provisions related to internal claims and appeals and the external review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affects plan procedures, notice content, timelines, and external reviewer processes for ERISA and non-ERISA plans; subject to PRA review and OMB approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) and Uniform Glossary development and utilization (PHS Act §2715)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2715 requires development and utilization of a uniform explanation of coverage documents and a standardized glossary (Summary of Benefits and Coverage and Uniform Glossary).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Informs required content, format, and distribution methods for consumer-facing summaries of benefits; agencies issue implementing regulations and information-collection notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grandfathered health plan disclosure, recordkeeping, and carrier-change disclosure requirements (section 1251)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 1251 provides that certain plans in existence as of March 23, 2010 (grandfathered health plans) are not required to comply with certain statutory ACA provisions; regulations specify disclosure, recordkeeping, and change-in-carrier disclosure obligations for grandfathered plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes what makes a plan grandfathered and what ongoing notices/records such plans must maintain and provide to enrollees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rescissions of health coverage rules (PHS Act §2712)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2712 and implementing regulations provide rules regarding rescissions of health coverage for group health plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines lawful grounds and procedural protections for rescinding coverage, including notice and appeals requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Exchange Improper Payment Measurement (SEIPM) implementation and measurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions include implementation of the State Exchange Improper Payment Measurement (SEIPM) to measure improper payments in Exchanges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes measurement methods, reporting, and potential remediation actions for improper payments at the State Exchange level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of adjustments to the Federal medical loss ratio (MLR) standard in the individual market
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rule seeks comment on potential adjustments to other Federal standards, including the Federal medical loss ratio (MLR) standard in the individual market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May lead to regulatory changes affecting issuer spending requirements and rebate calculations under MLR rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data submission requirements to receive Federally-facilitated Exchange user fee adjustments
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed information collection specifies data submission requirements related to coverage of certain preventive services to receive Federally-facilitated Exchange user fee adjustments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Impacts issuers' reporting obligations and the calculations used for Exchange user fees and adjustments.
